name: Document Processing Pipeline
description: A streaming pipeline that processes documents from Pub/Sub and upserts to Vector Search

parameters.helpText: The Pub/Sub subscription to read from
parameters.label: Input Pub/Sub Subscription
parameters.name: input_subscription

parameters.helpText: The Pub/Sub Topic to write success message to
parameters.label: Output Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.name: output_topic

parameters.helpText: Output file's window size in minutes
parameters.label: Window Size
parameters.name: window_size

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated GCS buckets the pipeline may read documents from or write Document AI output to. The pipeline rejects all GCS input if neither this nor ALLOWED_GCS_BUCKETS is set.
parameters.label: Allowed GCS buckets
parameters.name: allowed_gcs_buckets

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated projects allowed for GCS input and as the Document AI quota project.
parameters.label: Allowed GCP projects
parameters.name: allowed_gcp_projects

parameters.helpText: Optional comma-separated GCS object prefixes the pipeline may read.
parameters.label: Allowed GCS prefixes
parameters.name: allowed_gcs_prefixes

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Document AI processor resource names (projects/NUMBER/locations/LOCATION/processors/ID).
parameters.label: Allowed Document AI processors
parameters.name: allowed_docai_processors

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated projects that Vector Search upserts may target.
parameters.label: Allowed Vector Search projects
parameters.name: allowed_vector_store_projects

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated regions that Vector Search upserts may target (default: us-central1).
parameters.label: Allowed Vector Search regions
parameters.name: allowed_vector_store_regions

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Vector Search index IDs that may receive upserts.
parameters.label: Allowed Vector Search index IDs
parameters.name: allowed_vector_store_index_ids

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Vector Search index endpoint IDs that may receive upserts.
parameters.label: Allowed Vector Search endpoint IDs
parameters.name: allowed_vector_store_endpoint_ids

parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Vertex AI embedding models (default: text-embedding-004, text-embedding-preview-0815, text-multilingual-embedding-002).
parameters.label: Allowed embedding models
parameters.name: allowed_embedding_models
